display.title: The Aether
description: Floating islands and three dungeons (Slider, Valkyrie Queen, Sun Spirit). Falling is the danger; the gear line is unique.
&ePrepare:&r Slow falling / feather falling, a pickaxe for dungeon doors, ranged weapons for zephyrs.
&eSignature rewards:&r Skyward Plumes (exchange for Solar/Lightning gems), Aether accessories and dungeon keys (upstream).
&eComing back:&r Dungeons are one-time; plumes from ruined portals and bosses.
&eFeeds into:&r Plumes -> mobility gems; Aether gear is a sidegrade line.
